description: Difficulty curves: XP to level up and the enemy stat multiplier per floor. Calibrate with tests/balance_sim.tscn -- career.

fields.name: xp
fields.help: {base, per_level, per_level_sq}: XP from level L to L+1 = base + per_level x (L-1) + per_level_sq x (L-1)^2

fields.name: class_skill_levels
fields.help: Levels at which a hero learns their class's skills, in classes.json order: [1, 3, 6] = one at the start, the next at 3, the rest at 6.

fields.name: enemy_floor_mult
fields.help: 25 values: enemy stat multiplier for floors 1..25 (on top of enemy level = floor + 1)
